findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] docker-compose.yml: the compose file is the source of truth for the NetworkMode the runtime audit inspects, and it sets no network_mode: host on any service. All three services join named user-defined networks (frontend / backend, lines 62-64, 126-127, 189-190), which resolve to a bridge-type NetworkMode - the compliant value named in the CM's audit text. No how-tos on this CM, so Q2 skipped; Q3 alternative mitigation accepted - explicit per-service network attachment plus backend internal: true (line 225-226) keeps every container inside its own network stack, the same isolation property the docker inspect NetworkMode check verifies. Marker scan clean | verdict=pass confidence=high
